text.text_excerpt: This place is the reason why I come to NOLA. If you like Crawfish Boil, Big Fisherman is a MUST visit in New Orleans!! This place consistently makes it the BEST -- always fresh, and the Cajun boil flavors are the perfect blend of spice. The crabs are also good, but I come to New Orleans for the crawfish (given that it's in season in the spring). Big Fisherman is in the Garden District, so you can take the St. Charles trolley there and walk a few blocks, or drive (it's about 5 minutes from the French Quarter driving). Visit the landmark cemetary on the way there. Note that Big Fisherman is more of a fish store and there isn't a place to sit. We buy the Crawfish boil by the pound, and take ...

I love love love crawfish and the boiled crawfish here is great. Fully stocked with all kinds of beer and boiled seafood. Line can go out the door on a good day, but goes pretty quickly. Do not be fooled, this place is not a restaurant, it's more of a market where you get food, drinks, and leave. Suggest going to the levees to eat the crawfish! :)

I am from NYC and the only crawfish I've encountered were pinky sized frozen ones at the local asian supermarket and The Boil. The Boil is great but this was a refreshing take where the seafood you order is not doused in butter but steamed/broiled with some kind of old bay seasoning. We ordered 3LB of the jumbo crawfish at $4.29/LB, 1LB of jumbo shrimp at $9.99LB and some potatos,corn and sausage. The sausage we could have done without, it wasn't anything special but the crawfish were plump and tasty and filled with the yellow guts (which I love). The experience was like meditation for me.
